cases.name: Melissa Murphy Dunham
cases.about: Neighbor Denise Gadzacko described Melissa Dunham as a “wonderful mother.” Melissa was an accountant and partner at BMF - Bober Markey Fedorovich Life and Careers. Bober Markey Fedorovich Chief Operating Officer Sara Martin said in a statement. "Melissa was an esteemed member of the BMF leadership team and a close friend to many of our associates. Melissa's contributions during her 18 years with our firm have been immeasurable."
